items.title: The next workflow step for my role in Requires you
items.story: As Jordan, I want the next workflow step for my role in Requires you, so that I know what to do after my rejected work

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the next step for my role
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the workflow engine reports the next step "dev-loop · red" for role "developer" on "task-003-element-panel"
When I open Today
Then the Next workflow step card shows "dev-loop · red — task-003-element-panel"

acceptance_criteria.title: List rejected work before the next step
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3 with a next step for "developer"
And "task-005-sidebar" is a `draft` of Jordan's rejected with the reason "Breaks the layout"
When I open Today
Then Requires you lists "task-005-sidebar" above the Next workflow step card

acceptance_criteria.title: Say that no step waits for my role
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the workflow engine reports no next step for role "developer"
When I open Today
Then the Next workflow step card shows "No workflow step waits for developer"

items.title: The next-step area shown read-only with the reason
items.story: As Jordan, on a project whose WingFoil is older than 0.3, I want the next-step area shown read-only with the reason, so that I know why it is empty

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the next-step card read-only on WingFoil 0.2.2
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.2.2
When I open Today
Then the Next workflow step card shows "Needs WingFoil 0.3 (this project: 0.2.2)"
And the card shows no "Launch agent" button

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the same reason on a Kanban project
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the kanban fixture is open on WingFoil 0.2.2
When I open Today
Then the Next workflow step card shows "Needs WingFoil 0.3 (this project: 0.2.2)"

items.title: The progress card to show phase X of Y of the current workflow
items.story: As Casey, I want the progress card to show phase X of Y of the current workflow, so that I know where the project is in its life cycle

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the current phase of the scope
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Casey
Given the custom fixture with the sw-life-cycle preset is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the workflow engine reports `release-cycle` of "minor-v0.1" at phase "implementation"
When I open Today
Then the progress card shows "Phase 2 of 7 — implementation"
And the phase strip shows 1 phase done, 1 current and 5 to do

acceptance_criteria.title: Show a scope whose workflow has not started
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Casey
Given the custom fixture with the sw-life-cycle preset is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the workflow engine reports no run of `release-cycle` for "minor-v0.1"
When I open Today
Then the progress card shows "Not started — 0 of 7 phases"

items.title: The workflow tree to show the current position and who must act
items.story: As Jordan, I want the workflow tree to show the current position and who must act, so that I see where the process stands

acceptance_criteria.title: Mark the current position and who must act
steps: Given the console is running
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the workflow engine reports `sw-life-cycle` at "release-line-cycle" › "rl-v1" › "delivery" › "minor-v0.1" › "implementation" with role "developer"
When I open Workflow
Then "init", "inception" and "specification" are marked done
And "implementation" under "minor-v0.1" is marked current with "developer must act"

acceptance_criteria.title: Show no position on WingFoil 0.2.2
steps: Given the console is running
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.2.2
When I open Workflow
Then the tree shows no done/current marker and the note "Position needs WingFoil 0.3 (this project: 0.2.2)"

items.title: Report a bug through its ingestion with its required fields set by the CLI, when the project's WingFoil sets them …
items.story: As Jordan, I want to report a bug through its ingestion with its required fields set by the CLI, when the project's WingFoil sets them (field setter or `workflow start`), so that defects are captured in the UI too

acceptance_criteria.title: Report a bug with its severity set by the CLI
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on a WingFoil that sets the required fields of a bug
And I start "bug-ingest"
When I type the title "Toast hides the Push button", choose the severity "medium" and click "Submit"
Then the fixture's commits for "bug-002-toast-hides-the-push-button" are made by the CLI only
And the bug's frontmatter has `severity: medium` and the state "open"

acceptance_criteria.title: Keep the bug ingestion read-only on WingFoil 0.3 when it sets no fields
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on a WingFoil 0.3 whose `workflow start` does not set a bug's severity
When I click "+ Ingestion" on the Memory list
Then "bug-ingest" is shown disabled with "Needs a WingFoil that sets the required field severity"

items.title: The next step's context — role, directives, DNA modules, specs, branch — shown before launch
items.story: As Jordan, I want the next step's context — role, directives, DNA modules, specs, branch — shown before launch, so that I know what the agent will receive

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the context the agent will receive
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3 with the next step "dev-loop · red" on "task-003-element-panel"
When I expand the Next workflow step card
Then it shows the role "developer", the directives bound to "developer", the DNA module of the task, the specs it references and the branch "task/task-003-element-panel"

acceptance_criteria.title: Name the context items that are missing
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3 with the next step on "task-004-themes"
And "task-004-themes" declares no `module`
When I expand the Next workflow step card
Then the DNA module line reads "No module declared on task-004-themes"

items.title: Launch the agent on the next step or an element, with a confirmation when my settings ask for it
items.story: As Jordan, I want to launch the agent on the next step or an element, with a confirmation when my settings ask for it, so that the agent starts with the right context

acceptance_criteria.title: Launch the agent on the next step after confirming
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3 with the next step "dev-loop · red" on "task-003-element-panel"
And the UI setting "Confirm agent launch" is on
When I click "Launch agent" and confirm the modal showing the step's context and the branch "task/task-003-element-panel"
Then the server starts `wingfoil agent execute` for "task-003-element-panel" with role "developer"
And the button reads "View agent's logs"

acceptance_criteria.title: Launch without the modal when confirmation is off
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3 with a next step for "developer"
And the UI setting "Confirm agent launch" is off
When I click "Launch agent"
Then no modal is shown and the agent starts

acceptance_criteria.title: Cancel the launch from the modal
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3 with a next step for "developer"
And the UI setting "Confirm agent launch" is on
When I click "Launch agent" and then "Cancel" in the modal
Then no agent process is started

items.title: Launch an assisted review on an element
items.story: As Sam, I want to launch an assisted review on an element, so that an agent supports my review

acceptance_criteria.title: Launch an assisted review on an element
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the DNA gives Sam the roles reviewer
And I am Sam
When I click "Start assisted review" in the panel of "task-001-cli-adapter" and confirm
Then the server starts `wingfoil agent execute` for "task-001-cli-adapter" with role "reviewer"
And the button reads "View agent's logs"

acceptance_criteria.title: Offer no assisted review outside a gate state
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3
And I am Sam
When I open the element panel of "task-002-memory-list"
Then no "Start assisted review" button is shown

items.title: Launch agent shown read-only with the reason
items.story: As Jordan, on a project whose WingFoil cannot execute agents, I want Launch agent shown read-only with the reason, so that I know to run the agent outside the UI

acceptance_criteria.title: Show Launch agent read-only on WingFoil 0.2.2
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.2.2
When I open the element panel of "task-003-element-panel"
Then "Launch agent" is disabled with "Needs WingFoil 0.3 (this project: 0.2.2) — run the agent outside the UI"

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the same reason on the Kanban fixture
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the kanban fixture is open on WingFoil 0.2.2
When I open Today
Then the Next workflow step card shows no enabled "Launch agent" button

items.title: Launch agent to become View agent's logs and show the run's output live
items.story: As Jordan, I want Launch agent to become View agent's logs and show the run's output live, so that I follow it inside the UI

acceptance_criteria.title: Follow the run's output live
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given an agent run started from the UI on "task-003-element-panel" prints 1 line per second
When I click "View agent's logs"
Then the log view shows each new line within 2 seconds of the agent printing it
And it shows "Running" with the elapsed time

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the end of a successful run
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the log view of a run is open
When the agent exits with status 0
Then the log view shows "Finished · exit 0"
And the button on the step reads "Launch agent"

items.title: A failed run (non-zero exit) shown in the logs with its exit status and the button back to Launch agent
items.story: As Jordan, I want a failed run (non-zero exit) shown in the logs with its exit status and the button back to Launch agent, so that I can retry

acceptance_criteria.title: Show a failed run with its exit status
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the log view of a run is open
When the agent exits with status 2
Then the log view shows "Failed · exit 2" and keeps the output
And the button on the step reads "Launch agent"

acceptance_criteria.title: Report an agent that cannot start
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given `wingfoil agent execute` exits with an error before printing any output
When I launch the agent on the next step
Then a red toast shows the error message printed by `wingfoil agent execute`
And the button reads "Launch agent"

items.title: Agent log streaming
items.description: Lines printed by an agent run started from the UI appear in the log view.
items.fit_criterion: [numeric] Each line appears ≤ 2 s after the agent prints it, for 100 % of the lines of a 60-line run.

acceptance_criteria.title: Follow the run's output live
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given an agent run started from the UI on "task-003-element-panel" prints 1 line per second
When I click "View agent's logs"
Then the log view shows each new line within 2 seconds of the agent printing it
And it shows "Running" with the elapsed time

items.title: WingFoil 0.3 workflow and agent verbs
items.description: With WingFoil 0.3 the server reads the workflow position and the next step (`workflow status`, `workflow next`), starts ingestions through `workflow start` where it sets the required fields, and launches agents with `agent execute`, streaming their output. Exact options and output are confirmed against WingFoil 0.3 at v0.4 `release-planning` and captured as contracts (REQ-INT-01).
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] Every listed scenario passes on a fixture pinning WingFoil 0.3, and each verb used has a contract (REQ-INT-01).
